data: Which line represents the method with the highest accuracy when the number of seed examples is at its minimum?

The question asks which line represents the method with the highest accuracy when the number of seed examples is at its minimum. From the caption, we know that the number of seed examples ranges from 0 to 30. At the minimum number of seed examples (0), the accuracy values for all methods are approximately the same, around 90%. 

Looking at the graph, the line representing the method with the highest accuracy at this point appears to be the one labeled "DeltaS." This line starts at the highest point among all lines at the lowest number of seed examples. Therefore, the line representing the method with the highest accuracy when the number of seed examples is at its minimum is DeltaS.
